info.name: Accepts the invitation identified by the token.

items.docs:
Responds with 409 when the invitation is expired, already used, or was issued to a different
 email than the calling customer's.

info.name: Returns a paged list of organizations.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items per page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort fields. Prefix with - for descending order (e.g. -created_at).

params.name: logic
params.description: How to combine the field filters: "and" (default) requires every filter to match, "or" requires any of them to match.

items.docs: Returns a paged list of organizations.

info.name: Creates an organization and makes the calling customer its owner.

items.docs:
The calling customer becomes both the owner and the billing customer. Responds with 400 when
 the slug is already taken.

info.name: Returns the organization resolved from the calling customer's email domain.

items.docs: Responds with 404 when the caller's email domain does not match a registered organization.

info.name: Returns the organization with the given id.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: The id of the organization to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns the organization with the given id.

info.name: Creates an invitation to join the organization.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: The id of the organization to invite into.

items.docs: Returns a single-use token the invitee presents to the accept-invitation endpoint.

info.name: Returns the members of the given organization.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: The id of the organization whose members to list.

items.docs: Returns the members of the given organization.

info.name: Removes the given customer's membership from the organization.

params.name: customerId
params.description: The id of the customer to remove.

items.docs:
Responds with 404 when the customer is not a member and 409 when removing the organization's
 last owner.

info.name: Sets the support Slack channel URL for the organization owned by the given customer.

params.name: owner
params.description: The customer ID that owns the organization.

items.docs: A null or empty URL clears the channel. Responds with 404 when no organization is owned by the given customer.
